subject.title: fix(sessions): persist sender metadata in user turn transcript JSONL

question: Should OpenClaw persist senderId, senderName, and senderUsername for group/channel user turns in durable session JSONL while continuing to exclude phone/E164 metadata?
rationale: The code path looks bounded and tested, but deciding which user-identifying channel fields become durable transcript data is a privacy/security-boundary product choice.

options.title: Approve Bounded Metadata
options.body: Accept senderId, senderName, and senderUsername in durable group/channel JSONL with phone/E164 kept out and hooks still allowed to redact sender identity.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Require a smaller persisted field set or clearer documented privacy contract before merge.

options.title: Pause Or Reject Persistence
options.body: Defer or close this PR if durable participant identity should stay outside session JSONL for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Metadata
recommendation.body: Accept senderId, senderName, and senderUsername in durable group/channel JSONL with phone/E164 kept out and hooks still allowed to redact sender identity.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent commits on the PR head and adjacent inbound/session context work that owns the practical product boundary being decided.
